events.title: Tesla announces $1.5bn Bitcoin purchase

research.summary: Tesla disclosed in its annual report that it had updated its investment policy in January and invested an aggregate $1.5 billion in Bitcoin.
research.significance: A company of Tesla's size putting Bitcoin on its balance sheet pushed corporate treasury adoption into global mainstream finance.

events.title: Beeple NFT sells for $69m

research.summary: Christie's sold Beeple's Everydays: The First 5000 Days for $69,346,250 in a single-lot online auction.
research.significance: The sale made NFTs impossible for the traditional art market to ignore and set a world-record price for digital art at the time.

events.title: Coinbase goes public

research.summary: Coinbase completed a direct listing of its Class A common stock on Nasdaq under the ticker COIN.
research.significance: The listing brought a major crypto-native company directly into US public equity markets and created a new institutional bridge between crypto and traditional finance.

events.title: Dogecoin mania

research.summary: Dogecoin surged from an internet joke into one of the world's largest cryptocurrencies during the 2021 retail-speculation wave, reaching an approximately $80 billion market capitalization around the May SNL peak.
research.significance: The rally transformed meme coins from a niche joke into a major crypto market category.

sources.title: Reuters — Dogecoin in spotlight before SNL
Reuters — Dogecoin falls after Elon Musk SNL appearance

events.title: China mining crackdown

research.summary: China's Financial Stability and Development Committee explicitly called for a crackdown on Bitcoin mining and trading activities.
research.significance: The crackdown triggered a major geographic migration of Bitcoin hash rate and permanently reshaped the mining industry.

sources.title: Reuters — China State Council committee targets bitcoin mining

events.title: El Salvador Bitcoin legal-tender law takes effect

research.summary: El Salvador's Bitcoin Law took effect on 7 September 2021 and Bitcoin began circulating under the new legal-tender regime alongside the US dollar.
research.significance: This was the first real-world national implementation of Bitcoin legal tender.

sources.title: El Salvador Legislative Assembly — Bitcoin Law, Decree 57
El Salvador Presidency — Bitcoin/Chivo in use

events.title: Ethereum London upgrade / EIP-1559

research.summary: Ethereum activated the London upgrade at block 12,965,000, including EIP-1559's base-fee and fee-burning mechanism.
research.significance: London redesigned Ethereum's fee market, introduced ETH burning and became one of the most consequential protocol changes before the Merge.

events.title: Bored Ape Yacht Club launches

research.summary: Bored Ape Yacht Club launched a week-long presale of 10,000 NFTs at 0.08 ETH each; after a slow start, the remaining supply sold out on May 1.
research.significance: BAYC turned the profile-picture NFT into a membership, identity and brand ecosystem and became one of the defining collections of the NFT boom.

sources.title: Yuga Labs — The Birth of BAYC
Yuga Labs — Let's Make A NFT

events.title: China intensifies restrictions on cryptocurrency trading

research.summary: The People's Bank of China and other agencies issued a broad notice defining virtual-currency-related business activities as illegal financial activities and tightening enforcement.
research.significance: The September notice represented China's most comprehensive anti-crypto trading stance of the 2021 crackdown cycle.

sources.title: People's Bank of China — Sept 24 virtual currency notice

events.title: Poly Network exploit becomes famous for the return of stolen funds

research.summary: Poly Network disclosed a cross-chain exploit of roughly $610–612 million on 10 August 2021. The attacker began returning assets the next day and had returned almost all recoverable funds by 23 August.
research.significance: The episode was then the largest DeFi theft ever reported and became uniquely famous because the attacker returned nearly all of the stolen assets.

sources.title: Reuters — Poly Network hacker returns almost all funds

events.title: Axie Infinity and play-to-earn explode

research.summary: Axie Infinity reported more than 2 million daily active players by 12 October 2021 after explosive growth in its play-to-earn economy.
research.significance: Axie's boom made blockchain gaming and play-to-earn a global phenomenon, particularly in markets where scholarship guilds turned game assets into income-producing capital.

events.title: ConstitutionDAO attempts to buy a copy of the US Constitution

research.summary: ConstitutionDAO organized an internet-native crowdfunding effort to bid on a rare first printing of the US Constitution at Sotheby's. The DAO lost the auction, which closed at $43.173 million including premium, and later made refunds available.
research.significance: The effort became a defining example of rapid DAO coordination around a single real-world objective.

events.title: Bitcoin reaches roughly $69,000

research.summary: Bitcoin reached its 2021 cycle all-time high around $69,000 on 10 November, with the exact figure varying by exchange and index.
research.significance: The peak capped the institutional/NFT/meme-fueled 2021 bull market before the long 2022 unwind.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Bitcoin pulls back from November 10 all-time high

research.notes: Published copy should cite the specific exchange/index used for an exact price.

events.title: El Salvador passes the Bitcoin Law

research.summary: El Salvador's Legislative Assembly approved Decree 57, the Bitcoin Law, establishing Bitcoin as legal tender under the original 2021 law.
research.significance: El Salvador became the first sovereign state to legislate Bitcoin as legal tender, making government adoption a central chapter of crypto history.

sources.title: El Salvador Legislative Assembly — Bitcoin Law, Decree 57

events.title: Nigeria launches the eNaira CBDC

research.summary: Nigeria formally launched the eNaira, a central-bank digital currency issued as a direct liability of the Central Bank of Nigeria.
research.significance: The eNaira made Nigeria one of the first major economies to launch a live retail CBDC.

sources.title: Central Bank of Nigeria — eNaira launch release
Central Bank of Nigeria — eNaira regulatory guidelines

events.title: OpenSea becomes a defining marketplace of the NFT boom

research.summary: OpenSea's transaction volume and user activity exploded during the NFT boom; the company said transaction volume had grown more than 100x over the prior six months by March and raised major venture rounds during the year.
research.significance: OpenSea became the central marketplace of the 2021 NFT boom, but this row is an era/adoption node rather than one single event.

sources.title: OpenSea — $23M raise and NFT market growth

events.title: Art Blocks helps push generative NFT art into the mainstream

research.summary: Art Blocks and collections such as Chromie Squiggle helped establish long-form on-chain generative art as a major NFT category during 2021.
research.significance: The cultural breakthrough is real, but Art Blocks itself launched in November 2020; this row should remain 2021 adoption context rather than a launch event.

events.title: Facebook rebrands to Meta amid metaverse mania

research.summary: Facebook renamed its corporate parent Meta and publicly made building the metaverse a central strategic focus.
research.significance: Although not a crypto event by itself, the rebrand massively amplified the metaverse narrative that was already driving NFT and virtual-land speculation.
research.notes: Treat as adjacent-tech/cultural context, not evidence that Meta adopted cryptocurrency.

research.summary: Vitalik Buterin transferred more than 50 trillion SHIB plus other meme tokens to the India COVID-Crypto Relief Fund and other charities.
research.significance: The donation converted unsolicited meme-token wealth into one of crypto's most extraordinary philanthropic events and jolted the meme-token market.

sources.title: India Crypto Relief — what happened to Vitalik's SHIB donation

events.title: NFT profile-picture culture becomes a mainstream crypto identity phenomenon

research.summary: Profile-picture NFT collections became widespread social identity markers on Twitter and Discord during 2021, led by projects including CryptoPunks and BAYC.
research.significance: PFP culture changed NFTs from collectibles into visible online identity and status objects.

events.title: Uniswap V3 introduces concentrated liquidity

research.summary: Uniswap v3 deployed to Ethereum mainnet on 5 May 2021, introducing concentrated liquidity and multiple fee tiers.
research.significance: Concentrated liquidity dramatically increased capital efficiency and changed automated-market-maker design across DeFi.

events.title: Arbitrum mainnet opens a major optimistic-rollup era

research.summary: Arbitrum One opened publicly on 31 August 2021 after an earlier developer beta.
research.significance: Arbitrum's launch helped make optimistic rollups a practical, high-volume path for scaling Ethereum applications.

events.title: Optimism launches its optimistic rollup mainnet

research.summary: Optimism deployed its early production OP Mainnet in January 2021, initially with restricted contract deployment.
research.significance: It was one of the first major optimistic-rollup deployments and helped establish Ethereum's rollup-centric scaling direction.

events.title: Solana suffers a major network outage during rapid growth

research.summary: Solana's network went offline for roughly 17 hours after a surge of bot transactions around a token launch caused memory exhaustion and validator instability.
research.significance: The outage became the first major reliability crisis for a rapidly growing high-throughput Layer 1 and a recurring reference point in debates over Solana's resilience.

events.title: Terra UST and LUNA ecosystem expands rapidly

research.summary: Terra's UST and LUNA ecosystem expanded rapidly during 2021 as Anchor, Mirror and other applications increased UST demand and network value.
research.significance: This is a growth-era node connecting Anchor's yield model to the much larger 2022 Terra collapse.

events.title: Anchor Protocol high stablecoin yield becomes central to Terra growth

research.summary: Anchor Protocol launched on Terra on 17 March 2021 advertising a roughly 20% target yield on UST deposits; Terra reported $100 million in deposits within four days.
research.significance: Anchor's unusually high stablecoin yield became the primary demand engine for UST and a crucial precondition for Terra's later systemic fragility.

events.title: OlympusDAO popularizes protocol-owned liquidity and 3,3 culture

research.summary: OlympusDAO launched in March 2021 and pioneered protocol-owned liquidity, later popularizing the game-theory meme '(3,3)' around staking and bonding.
research.significance: Olympus created one of DeFi's most copied liquidity models and one of the bull market's most recognizable protocol memes.
research.notes: Exact canonical launch day and primary 2021 launch post still need to be attached before full VERIFIED status.

research.summary: ENS launched the ENS governance token and DAO; 25% of supply was allocated for an airdrop to eligible historical .eth registrants.
research.significance: The airdrop rewarded early users, transferred governance toward a DAO and became one of 2021's defining retroactive distributions.

events.title: Avalanche Rush incentives accelerate ecosystem growth

events.title: dYdX grows as a major decentralized perpetuals venue

research.significance: dYdX became one of the leading decentralized perpetual-futures venues and demonstrated that sophisticated leveraged trading could move on-chain.

research.significance: Lido's growth made liquid staking a major DeFi primitive and created one of Ethereum's most consequential staking intermediaries.
research.notes: This is a 2021 growth/dominance milestone, not Lido's original launch date.
